trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the platinum by unlocking every other trophy in the game — all 54 of them, from the story chapters to 100% completion. There is no shortcut: the platinum pops the moment the last of the 54 is yours. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, side content second, cleanup last — and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Gone Fishing. It is the game's opening mission, so it comes naturally at the start of the story and cannot be missed — just play from the beginning and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Story trophies cannot be missed, and missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu after you beat the game, so just keep playing the story and this pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Like every chapter trophy it cannot be missed — play the story through and it pops at the chapter's end. If you ever need to redo a mission, the mission replay menu opens after you beat the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Chapter trophies cannot be missed; keep playing the story and it pops at the chapter's end. Missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu once the game is beaten.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Chapter trophies cannot be missed — play the story through and it pops at the chapter's end. The mission replay menu, open after you beat the game, covers any mission you want to redo.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the campaign's last mission, so it pops when you finish the story; like every story trophy it cannot be missed, and the mission can be replayed afterwards from the mission replay menu.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Play through the story until this mission appears and finish it; story missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu if you ever need to.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It appears as you play through the story — finish it and the trophy pops. Story missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu after the game is beaten.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it; story missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu if you ever need to.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It comes up as you play through the story — finish it and the trophy pops. Story missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu after the game is beaten.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it; story missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu if you ever need to.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It appears as you play through the story — finish it and the trophy pops. Story missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu after the game is beaten.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. PowerPyx's 100% checklist counts 100 objectives in the game: every story mission, all 16 Strangers & Freaks missions, every side activity and the collectibles that count toward completion. Nothing in 100% is missable, and story missions can be replayed from the mission replay menu, so this is a long cleanup trophy, not a race — save it for after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts, as the official description counts them. Stunts are the game's driving stunt actions — jumps, near misses and the like — and the counter runs across the whole game, so they build up naturally as you drive. One launch-day note (PowerPyx) mentions 24 unique stunt jumps instead; the official description's 250 is the number this guide follows.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The bundled starter data lists nine activity types in the game — play one round or one session of each and the trophy pops. Activities include the shooting range, drone races, fishing, bowling, darts and pool among others.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. The range sits in the back room of an Ammu-Nation store, and each challenge covers a different weapon type — pistols, SMGs, shotguns, rifles, snipers, heavy weapons and throwables — with three parts that must all finish inside the time limit for gold. Launch-day sources disagree on the count (PowerPyx's shooting-range page lists 12 challenges; the bundled starter data lists 42), so gold every challenge the range offers and let the in-game list decide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PowerPyx's drone-race page lists 10 races; the bundled starter data lists 14 locations — the two counts disagree on launch day, so win at every location the game offers and the trophy pops when the last one is done.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road races, drone races and the rest — so work through the race types as you meet them; winning the same race twice does not count twice.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities — find Cal, take the fishing challenge he offers and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine in the world and finish a game on it — any game counts, just see it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger contacts whose mission strand builds across the game; finish his last mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's mission strand builds across the game; finish his last mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's mission strand builds across the game; finish his last mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger strands are the side missions for odd characters around the map — finish eight full strands. Note the separate 100% figure: PowerPyx's 100% checklist says 16 Strangers & Freaks missions count toward 100% completion, which is a different requirement from this trophy's 8 strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's mission strand builds across the game; finish his last mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's mission strand builds across the game; finish his last mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. The bundled starter data lists 18 meditation spots. One warning: Push Square flags a possible missable here — in Chapter 1, Lucia can meditate in her kitchen, and Push Square says if you skip it you cannot go back to it later. PowerPyx says meditation is also available in the open world after the story, but does not confirm it is the same meditation, so do the kitchen meditation the first time you see it in Chapter 1, then sweep the remaining spots after the story.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is a hunting one — follow his missions until the unique animal hunt opens, then take the animal down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are a collectible scattered around Leonida — gather full sets, and three completed sets pop the trophy. Nothing about the cards is missable, so collect them as you explore and finish the sets in cleanup.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo and location check-in activity — visit 100 distinct locations and WAiNK It at each. It pairs naturally with exploring all of Leonida, so do it as you travel rather than as a separate grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — they stack up across activities, driving, combat and exploration, so this pops naturally on the road to 100% if you vary what you do instead of repeating one thing.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the police to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. A quiet stretch of countryside and a fast car help.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner along, keeping the wanted level alive between robberies — do not let it clear and do not get caught. Plan a route of three close shops and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovering means finding new vehicle models in the world — drive around Leonida, check parking lots, traffic and dealerships, and the count climbs as you encounter models you have not seen before.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-down aiming mode — trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight and make every shot count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the Vice City International Airport — leave it in a way the airport did not schedule, which in practice means stealing a plane and taking off rather than using a booked flight.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke with no instructions: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' Rhinos are the game's tanks, so this trophy is tied to tank action — but no detailed method is public on launch day (2026-11-19). One launch-day note suggests escaping a 3-star wanted level in a tank; that is unconfirmed, so treat it as a lead, not a fact.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — no cameras tripped, no witnesses. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so plan the exit before you go in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean getaway — the escape counts, so do not get caught after the vault is open.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, take the cash and get away clean.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The bundled starter data lists 52 areas — visit every one, from Vice City's streets to the far corners of the state, and the trophy pops when the last area registers. The in-game map tracks where you have been.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. The bundled starter data lists nine gangs — hit one illegal operation for every gang in the state. Each gang's operations are marked in their territory, so work through the map gang by gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side — the 'classic style' is the old-school smash-and-grab exit, so pick a showroom with a clear run out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — any game counts, just finish it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is cryptic — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — and no detailed method is public on launch day (2026-11-19). It reads like a co-op or partner-activity trophy, but that is a guess; this guide does not invent a method where none is published.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The official description is cryptic — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — and no detailed method is public on launch day (2026-11-19). It appears to track story choices, but which choices and how many is not published yet.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The official description is a shrug — 'Second time's the charm' — and no detailed method is public on launch day (2026-11-19). The wording suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, but that is a guess, not a published method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description is a question — 'What the hell just happened?' — and no confirmed method is public on launch day (2026-11-19). One launch-day note suggests a UFO sighting; that is unconfirmed, so treat it as a lead, not a fact.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Despite the bowling-sounding name, the official description is about a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow drive-by past a pedestrian and swing as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from heists — pass $250,000 of them through your laundering contacts and the trophy pops. This is a long grind, so start laundering early.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shops count — clothes, weapons, food, car parts — and the total is cumulative across the whole game, so it pops naturally if you spend as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. The bundled starter data lists eight garage properties — buy every one and the trophy pops. Garages are bought through the in-game property market, so save up and work through the list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app is the game's vehicle service — register ten different vehicles to it and the trophy pops.
